capabilities: play one audio instance across the whole vault
keep playback running after closing the tab
display a wave visualizer for audio files
add bookmarks by double-clicking the visualizer or via text
pause and resume playback through commands
disambiguation: Not an audio recorder; it plays existing audio files embedded in notes, unlike the core Audio recorder feature.
extras: Free; the author accepts donations via buy-me-a-coffee. The demo section appears empty in the text and installation is documented for community plugins and Git.
problem: Obsidian's default HTML5 audio embed is basic: playback stops when the tab closes, there is no waveform, and no way to bookmark positions in a track.
summary: Audio player that replaces the default HTML5 audio embed with a wave visualizer, vault-wide single playback, and audio bookmarks.
